verses.1: To be destroyed by music on the eighth note – a song for David.
verses.2: May the LORD not let me fall, and may He not abandon me in your hands.
verses.3: Save me, O LORD! For I am in need of healing. Restore me, O LORD! For my soul is in distress.
verses.4: And my soul is filled with fear, and you, LORD, are eternal.
verses.5: May the LORD save my soul, so that I may receive Your mercy.
verses.6: For in darkness, no one will remember you. Who will take care of you then?
verses.7: I will suffer from sighs every night. My heart burns with pain. My womb is filled with sorrow.
verses.8: My eyes were filled with anger, and it remained there in every situation.
verses.9: Let all the works of Aon be destroyed from me, when Jehovah hears the cry in Kiyi.
verses.10: Hear, O LORD, my cries; hear, O LORD, my pleas for help.
verses.11: They will be terrified and frightened greatly. All their enemies will be destroyed. They will be in fear for a moment.
